page0.text:
...There's no helping it now.
I'll tell her the facts without giving away too much.

page1.text:
"Senpai, who was in your dream?"
"Well, uh, the only one there was Tohsaka—"
She immediately lures me into spilling the beans.

page2.text:
"I see. Tohsaka-senpai did come over before, didn't she?"
"Uh...yeah. She just gave me some first aid and left right after."

page3.text:
"...I understand. I'll leave the thermometer here, then."
Sakura sets the thermometer down on the floor and walks to the bedroom door with heavy steps.
